package {{Package}};

// A program a JCL step runs, by EXEC PGM= or by RUN PROGRAM under the TSO monitor.
public interface BatchProgram {
    // The program name the JCL uses.
    String programId();

    // Returns the program's RETURN-CODE. Throwing ends the step as an abend; throw
    // BatchAbendException to give the abend a code.
    int run(BatchStepContext context) throws Exception;
}
//// FILE: JclCompare.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

public enum JclCompare {
    GT, LT, EQ, NE, GE, LE;

    public boolean test(int left, int right) {
        switch (this) {
            case GT: return left > right;
            case LT: return left < right;
            case EQ: return left == right;
            case NE: return left != right;
            case GE: return left >= right;
            default: return left <= right;
        }
    }
}

// Ends a step as an abend with a code such as U0100 or S0C7.
public class BatchAbendException extends RuntimeException {

    public BatchAbendException(String code, String message) { super(message); this.code = code; }
    public BatchAbendException(String code, String message, Throwable cause) { super(message, cause); this.code = code; }

    public String code() { return code; }
}

//// FILE: JclJobState.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.Serializable;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

// What the steps run so far did, as IF and COND read it. A step that abended or did not run has
// no return code, so every comparison with it is false.
public final class JclJobState implements Serializable {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    private final String runId;
    private final List<JclStepOutcome> outcomes = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean terminated;

    public JclJobState(String runId) { this.runId = runId; }

    public String runId() { return runId; }
    public List<JclStepOutcome> outcomes() { return outcomes; }
    public boolean terminated() { return terminated; }
    void terminate() { terminated = true; }
    void add(JclStepOutcome outcome) { outcomes.add(outcome); }

    public boolean anyAbend() { return outcomes.stream().anyMatch(JclStepOutcome::abended); }

    // A name that called a procedure stands for all of its steps.
    public Stream<JclStepOutcome> matching(String step) {
        if (step == null) return outcomes.stream();
        return outcomes.stream().filter(o -> o.step().equalsIgnoreCase(step)
                || o.step().toUpperCase().startsWith(step.toUpperCase() + "."));
    }

    public boolean rc(String step, JclCompare op, int value) {
        return matching(step).filter(o -> o.ran() && !o.abended() && o.returnCode() != null)
                .mapToInt(JclStepOutcome::returnCode).max().stream().anyMatch(rc -> op.test(rc, value));
    }

    public boolean abendCc(String step, JclCompare op, String code) {
        var wanted = normalize(code);
        var codes = matching(step).filter(o -> o.abended() && o.abendCode() != null).map(o -> normalize(o.abendCode())).toList();
        if (codes.isEmpty()) return false;
        return op == JclCompare.NE ? codes.stream().noneMatch(wanted::equals) : codes.contains(wanted);
    }

    public boolean abended(String step) { return matching(step).anyMatch(JclStepOutcome::abended); }

    public boolean ran(String step) { return matching(step).anyMatch(JclStepOutcome::ran); }

    private static String normalize(String code) {
        var c = code.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (c.startsWith("U")) {
            try { return String.format("U%04d", Integer.parseInt(c.substring(1))); } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        return c;
    }
}
//// FILE: DatasetCatalog.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;

public interface DatasetCatalog {
    // A run keeps relative generations fixed, as a mainframe job does.
    Path resolve(String runId, JclDd dd);
    Path sysOutPath(String runId, String job, String step, String dd);
    void delete(String runId, JclDd dd) throws IOException;
    void endJob(String runId) throws IOException;
}
//// FILE: DirectoryDatasetCatalog.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

// Datasets as files under one root: A.B.C is <root>/A.B.C, a member is a file inside it, and a
// generation data group is a directory of G0001V00, G0002V00, ...
public final class DirectoryDatasetCatalog implements DatasetCatalog {
    private static final Pattern GENERATION_FILE = Pattern.compile("^G(\\d{4})V00$");
    private final Path root;
    private final Map<String, Integer> current = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public DirectoryDatasetCatalog(Path root) { this.root = root.toAbsolutePath().normalize(); }

    @Override
    public Path resolve(String runId, JclDd dd) {
        if (dd.dataset() == null) throw new IllegalStateException("DD " + dd.name() + " names no dataset.");
        if (dd.isTemporary()) return under(root.resolve(".temp").resolve(runId).resolve(name(dd.dataset().replaceFirst("^&+", ""))));
        var path = root.resolve(name(dd.dataset()));
        if (dd.generation() != null) path = path.resolve(generation(runId, dd.dataset(), path, dd.generation()));
        if (dd.member() != null) path = path.resolve(name(dd.member()));
        return under(path);
    }

    @Override
    public Path sysOutPath(String runId, String job, String step, String dd) {
        return under(root.resolve(".sysout").resolve(name(job)).resolve(runId).resolve(name(step) + "." + name(dd) + ".txt"));
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(String runId, JclDd dd) throws IOException { deleteTree(resolve(runId, dd)); }

    @Override
    public void endJob(String runId) throws IOException {
        deleteTree(root.resolve(".temp").resolve(runId));
        current.keySet().removeIf(k -> k.startsWith(runId + "|"));
    }

    static void deleteTree(Path path) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return;
        try (Stream<Path> walk = Files.walk(path)) {
            for (var p : walk.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList()) Files.delete(p);
        }
    }

    private String generation(String runId, String name, Path directory, String relative) {
        int now = current.computeIfAbsent(runId + "|" + name, k -> highest(directory));
        int number = now + Integer.parseInt(relative.replace("+", ""));
        if (number < 1) throw new UncheckedIOException(new NoSuchFileException(
                name + "(" + relative + ") does not exist: the group has " + now + " generation(s)."));
        return String.format("G%04dV00", number);
    }

    private static int highest(Path directory) {
        if (!Files.isDirectory(directory)) return 0;
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(directory)) {
            return files.map(f -> GENERATION_FILE.matcher(f.getFileName().toString()))
                    .filter(java.util.regex.Matcher::matches).mapToInt(m -> Integer.parseInt(m.group(1))).max().orElse(0);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
        }
    }

    // A name must stay one entry under the root: an empty one, or one of dots alone, would
    // resolve to the root or its parent, which a DELETE would then remove.
    private static String name(String name) {
        var safe = name.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9.$#@_-]", "_");
        if (safe.replace(".", "").isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("'" + name + "' is not a usable dataset name.");
        return safe;
    }

    private Path under(Path path) {
        var full = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (!full.startsWith(root) || full.equals(root)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(path + " is outside the dataset root " + root + ".");
        return full;
    }
}
//// FILE: BatchStepContext.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.SequenceInputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public final class BatchStepContext {
    private final String job;
    private final String step;
    private final String runId;
    private final String programId;
    private final String parm;
    private final JclDb2Run db2;
    private final Map<String, JclDd> dds = new TreeMap<>(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER);
    private final List<String> controlStatements;
    private final DatasetCatalog datasets;

    public BatchStepContext(String job, String step, String runId, String programId, String parm, JclDb2Run db2,
                            List<JclDd> dds, List<String> controlStatements, DatasetCatalog datasets) {
        this.job = job;
        this.step = step;
        this.runId = runId;
        this.programId = programId;
        this.parm = parm;
        this.db2 = db2;
        for (var dd : dds) {
            var name = dd.name();
            this.dds.put(name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1), dd);
        }
        this.controlStatements = controlStatements;
        this.datasets = datasets;
    }

    public String job() { return job; }
    public String step() { return step; }
    public String programId() { return programId; }
    public String parm() { return parm; }
    public String db2Plan() { return db2 == null ? null : db2.plan(); }
    public String db2Subsystem() { return db2 == null ? null : db2.subsystem(); }
    public Map<String, JclDd> dds() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(dds); }
    public List<String> controlStatements() { return controlStatements; }

    public boolean has(String dd) { return dds.containsKey(dd); }

    public JclDd dd(String dd) {
        var found = dds.get(dd);
        if (found == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Step " + step + " of " + job + " has no DD " + dd + ".");
        return found;
    }

    // The file behind a DD; null when it is DUMMY or in-stream.
    public Path pathFor(String dd) { return pathFor(dd(dd)); }

    public Path resolveDataset(String name) { return datasets.resolve(runId, JclDd.of("").dataset(name)); }

    public List<String> inStream(String dd) {
        var lines = dd(dd).inStream();
        return lines == null ? List.of() : lines;
    }

    public InputStream openRead(String dd) throws IOException {
        var first = dd(dd);
        var parts = new ArrayList<InputStream>();
        try {
            parts.add(openOne(first));
            for (var next : first.concatenated()) parts.add(openOne(next));
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            for (var opened : parts) {
                try { opened.close(); } catch (IOException suppressed) { e.addSuppressed(suppressed); }
            }
            throw e;
        }
        return parts.size() == 1 ? parts.get(0) : new SequenceInputStream(Collections.enumeration(parts));
    }

    public OutputStream openWrite(String dd) throws IOException {
        var target = dd(dd);
        if (target.isDummy()) return OutputStream.nullOutputStream();
        var path = pathFor(target);
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalStateException("DD " + dd + " of step " + step + " is in-stream and cannot be written.");
        Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
        return "MOD".equals(target.status()) || target.sysOut() != null
                ? Files.newOutputStream(path, StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.APPEND)
                : Files.newOutputStream(path);
    }

    Path pathFor(JclDd dd) {
        if (dd.isDummy() || dd.inStream() != null) return null;
        if (dd.sysOut() != null) return datasets.sysOutPath(runId, job, step, dd.name());
        return dd.dataset() == null ? null : datasets.resolve(runId, dd);
    }

    private InputStream openOne(JclDd dd) throws IOException {
        if (dd.isDummy()) return InputStream.nullInputStream();
        if (dd.inStream() != null) {
            var text = new StringBuilder();
            for (var line : dd.inStream()) text.append(line).append('\n');
            return new ByteArrayInputStream(text.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
        var path = pathFor(dd);
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalStateException("DD " + dd.name() + " of step " + step + " has nothing to read.");
        return Files.newInputStream(path);
    }
}
//// FILE: JobUtilities.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.

//// FILE: DefaultJobUtilities.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

// IEFBR14 and the IDCAMS commands that act on files: DELETE, REPRO, DEFINE and SET. Anything else
// stops the job and names the utility, rather than pretending to have run it.
public class DefaultJobUtilities implements JobUtilities {
    private static final Pattern KEYWORD = Pattern.compile("\\b([A-Z]+)\\s*\\(\\s*([^()]*)\\)", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern SET = Pattern.compile("^(MAXCC|LASTCC)\\s*=\\s*(\\d+)$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);

    @Override
    public int run(String program, BatchStepContext context) throws Exception {
        switch (program.toUpperCase()) {
            case "IEFBR14": return 0;
            case "IDCAMS": return idcams(context);
            default:
                throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + context.step() + " runs " + program
                        + ", which has no generated equivalent. Implement JobUtilities for it; "
                        + "its control statements are in BatchStepContext.controlStatements().");
        }
    }

    private static int idcams(BatchStepContext context) throws IOException {
        int maxcc = 0, lastcc = 0;
        for (var command : commands(context.controlStatements())) {
            var verb = command.split(" ", 2)[0].toUpperCase();
            var rest = command.length() > verb.length() ? command.substring(verb.length()).trim() : "";
            switch (verb) {
                case "DELETE", "DEL" -> {
                    // DELETE ( A.B.C ) PURGE: the entry is the first word that is not a parenthesis.
                    var name = java.util.Arrays.stream(rest.split("[\\s()]+")).filter(t -> !t.isEmpty()).findFirst().orElse("").replaceAll("^'+|'+$", "");
                    if (name.isEmpty()) throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + context.step() + ": IDCAMS " + command + " names no entry.");
                    var path = context.resolveDataset(name);
                    if (Files.exists(path)) { DirectoryDatasetCatalog.deleteTree(path); lastcc = 0; } else lastcc = 8;
                }
                case "REPRO" -> {
                    var arguments = arguments(rest);
                    try (InputStream in = arguments.containsKey("INFILE") ? context.openRead(arguments.get("INFILE"))
                                : Files.newInputStream(context.resolveDataset(required(arguments, "INDATASET", "IDS")));
                         OutputStream out = arguments.containsKey("OUTFILE") ? context.openWrite(arguments.get("OUTFILE"))
                                : create(context.resolveDataset(required(arguments, "OUTDATASET", "ODS")))) {
                        in.transferTo(out);
                    }
                    lastcc = 0;
                }
                case "DEFINE", "DEF" -> {
                    var defined = arguments(rest).get("NAME");
                    if (defined == null) throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + context.step() + ": DEFINE without NAME: " + command);
                    var target = context.resolveDataset(defined);
                    if (rest.toUpperCase().startsWith("GDG")) Files.createDirectories(target);
                    else if (!Files.exists(target)) create(target).close();
                    lastcc = 0;
                }
                case "SET" -> {
                    var assignment = SET.matcher(rest);
                    if (!assignment.matches()) throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + context.step() + ": IDCAMS " + command + " is not supported.");
                    var value = Integer.parseInt(assignment.group(2));
                    if (assignment.group(1).equalsIgnoreCase("MAXCC")) { maxcc = value; continue; }
                    lastcc = value;
                }
                default -> throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + context.step() + ": IDCAMS " + verb + " has no generated equivalent.");
            }
            maxcc = Math.max(maxcc, lastcc);
        }
        return maxcc;
    }

    private static OutputStream create(Path path) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
        return Files.newOutputStream(path);
    }

    private static String required(Map<String, String> arguments, String... keys) {
        for (var key : keys) if (arguments.containsKey(key)) return arguments.get(key);
        throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("REPRO needs " + String.join(" or ", keys) + ".");
    }

    private static Map<String, String> arguments(String text) {
        var result = new HashMap<String, String>();
        var matcher = KEYWORD.matcher(text);
        while (matcher.find()) result.putIfAbsent(matcher.group(1).toUpperCase(), matcher.group(2).trim().replace("'", ""));
        return result;
    }

    // A trailing '-' or '+' continues a command; /* ... */ is a comment.
    private static List<String> commands(List<String> lines) {
        var result = new ArrayList<String>();
        var current = new StringBuilder();
        for (var raw : lines) {
            var line = raw.replaceAll("/\\*.*?\\*/", " ").trim();
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            var continued = line.endsWith("-") || line.endsWith("+");
            if (current.length() > 0) current.append(' ');
            current.append(continued ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1).trim() : line);
            if (continued) continue;
            result.add(current.toString());
            current.setLength(0);
        }
        if (current.length() > 0) result.add(current.toString());
        return result;
    }
}
//// FILE: JclJobRunner.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

// Runs a job the way z/OS does: IF/THEN/ELSE and COND decide each step, JOB COND ends the job,
// and after an abend only steps that ask for it (COND=EVEN/ONLY, or IF testing ABEND) run.
public final class JclJobRunner {
    private final Map<String, BatchProgram> programs = new HashMap<>();
    private final DatasetCatalog datasets;
    private final JobUtilities utilities;

    public JclJobRunner(List<BatchProgram> programs, DatasetCatalog datasets, JobUtilities utilities) {
        for (var program : programs) {
            if (this.programs.putIfAbsent(program.programId().toUpperCase(), program) != null)
                throw new IllegalStateException("Two batch programs have the id " + program.programId() + ".");
        }
        this.datasets = datasets;
        this.utilities = utilities == null ? new DefaultJobUtilities() : utilities;
    }

    public DatasetCatalog datasets() { return datasets; }

    public static String newRunId() {
        return LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS")) + "-" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0, 8);
    }

    public List<JclStepOutcome> run(JclJob job) throws IOException {
        var state = new JclJobState(newRunId());
        try {
            for (var step : job.steps()) runStep(job, step, state);
        } finally {
            datasets.endJob(state.runId());
        }
        return state.outcomes();
    }

    // One step: decides whether it runs, runs it, and records the outcome in the state.
    public JclStepOutcome runStep(JclJob job, JclStepDefinition step, JclJobState state) {
        if (state.terminated() || !shouldRun(step, state)) {
            var bypassed = new JclStepOutcome(step.name(), false, null, null, false, state.terminated() ? "JOB COND ended the job" : "bypassed");
            state.add(bypassed);
            return bypassed;
        }
        var outcome = execute(job, step, state.runId());
        state.add(outcome);
        if (!outcome.abended() && outcome.returnCode() != null && job.cond() != null
                && job.cond().tests().stream().anyMatch(t -> t.op().test(t.code(), outcome.returnCode())))
            state.terminate();
        return outcome;
    }

    private static boolean shouldRun(JclStepDefinition step, JclJobState state) {
        if (step.guardError() != null)
            throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + step.name() + ": the condition could not be read: " + step.guardError());

        var abended = state.anyAbend();
        var cond = step.cond();
        var asksForAbend = cond != null && (cond.even() || cond.only());
        if (step.guard() != null) {
            if (!step.guard().test(state)) return false;
            if (abended && !step.guardTestsAbend() && !asksForAbend) return false;
        } else if (abended && !asksForAbend) {
            return false;
        }

        if (cond != null) {
            if (cond.only() && !abended) return false;
            for (var test : cond.tests()) {
                var bypass = state.matching(test.step()).filter(o -> o.ran() && !o.abended() && o.returnCode() != null)
                        .anyMatch(o -> test.op().test(test.code(), o.returnCode()));
                if (bypass) return false;
            }
        }

        if (step.kind() == JclStepKind.UNRESOLVED)
            throw new JclStepNotRunnableException("Step " + step.name() + " calls procedure " + step.procedure()
                    + ", which is not in the source. Add it and regenerate the job.");
        return true;
    }

    private JclStepOutcome execute(JclJob job, JclStepDefinition step, String runId) {
        try {
            int rc;
            switch (step.kind()) {
                case PROGRAM -> rc = program(step.program()).run(context(job, step, runId, step.program(), step.parm(), null));
                case TSO -> {
                    rc = 0;
                    for (var run : step.runs()) rc = program(run.program()).run(context(job, step, runId, run.program(), run.parms(), run));
                }
                default -> rc = utilities.run(step.program() == null ? "" : step.program(), context(job, step, runId, step.program(), step.parm(), null));
            }
            dispose(step, runId, true);
            return new JclStepOutcome(step.name(), true, rc, null, false, null);
        } catch (JclStepNotRunnableException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try { dispose(step, runId, false); } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ignored) {
                // Cleanup after an abend must not hide the abend.
            }
            return new JclStepOutcome(step.name(), true, null, e instanceof BatchAbendException b ? b.code() : null, true, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private BatchProgram program(String id) {
        var program = programs.get(id.toUpperCase());
        if (program == null) throw new BatchAbendException("S806", "Program " + id + " was not found: no BatchProgram has that programId.");
        return program;
    }

    private BatchStepContext context(JclJob job, JclStepDefinition step, String runId, String programId, String parm, JclDb2Run db2) {
        return new BatchStepContext(job.name(), step.name(), runId, programId, parm, db2, step.dds(), step.controlStatements(), datasets);
    }

    // A new dataset the step kept exists afterwards even if the step never wrote it, as allocation
    // does; DELETE removes it. Temporary datasets follow their disposition too, and whatever
    // is left of them goes when the job ends.
    private void dispose(JclStepDefinition step, String runId, boolean normal) throws IOException {
        for (var first : step.dds()) {
            for (var dd : java.util.stream.Stream.concat(java.util.stream.Stream.of(first), first.concatenated().stream()).toList()) {
                if (dd.dataset() == null) continue;
                var disposition = normal || dd.abnormalDisposition() == null ? dd.normalDisposition() : dd.abnormalDisposition();
                if ("DELETE".equals(disposition)) { datasets.delete(runId, dd); continue; }
                var status = dd.status() == null ? "NEW" : dd.status();
                if (normal && status.equals("NEW") && dd.member() == null) {
                    var path = datasets.resolve(runId, dd);
                    if (!Files.exists(path)) {
                        Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
                        Files.createFile(path);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
//// FILE: JclSpringBatch.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import org.springframework.batch.core.ExitStatus;
import org.springframework.batch.core.Job;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecutionListener;
import org.springframework.batch.core.Step;
import org.springframework.batch.core.job.builder.JobBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.core.job.builder.SimpleJobBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.core.repository.JobRepository;
import org.springframework.batch.core.step.builder.StepBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.repeat.RepeatStatus;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;

// One Spring Batch step per JCL step, in JCL order. Whether a step runs is decided by the JCL
// rules in JclJobRunner, so a bypassed step completes with exit status BYPASSED rather than
// being left out of the flow. The IF/COND state lives in the job's execution context.
public final class JclSpringBatch {
    public static final String STATE_KEY = "jcl.state";

    private JclSpringBatch() { }

    public static Job build(JclJob definition, JobRepository repository, PlatformTransactionManager transactions, JclJobRunner runner) {
        SimpleJobBuilder flow = null;
        for (var step : definition.steps()) {
            var built = step(definition, step, repository, transactions, runner);
            flow = flow == null ? new JobBuilder(definition.name(), repository).start(built) : flow.next(built);
        }
        if (flow == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Job " + definition.name() + " has no steps.");
        return flow.listener(new JobExecutionListener() {
            @Override
            public void beforeJob(JobExecution execution) {
                if (!execution.getExecutionContext().containsKey(STATE_KEY))
                    execution.getExecutionContext().put(STATE_KEY, new JclJobState(JclJobRunner.newRunId()));
            }

            @Override
            public void afterJob(JobExecution execution) {
                var state = (JclJobState) execution.getExecutionContext().get(STATE_KEY);
                if (state == null) return;
                // Every step completes as far as Spring Batch knows, so the job's own outcome is
                // carried in its exit status, as the scheduler would have read it off the job.
                if (state.anyAbend()) execution.setExitStatus(new ExitStatus("ABENDED", "A step abended."));
                else if (execution.getExitStatus().getExitCode().equals(ExitStatus.COMPLETED.getExitCode()))
                    execution.setExitStatus(new ExitStatus(ExitStatus.COMPLETED.getExitCode(), "MAXCC=" + state.outcomes().stream()
                            .filter(o -> o.returnCode() != null).mapToInt(JclStepOutcome::returnCode).max().orElse(0)));
                try { runner.datasets().endJob(state.runId()); } catch (IOException e) { throw new UncheckedIOException(e); }
            }
        }).build();
    }

    private static Step step(JclJob definition, JclStepDefinition step, JobRepository repository,
                             PlatformTransactionManager transactions, JclJobRunner runner) {
        return new StepBuilder(definition.name() + "." + step.name(), repository)
                .tasklet((contribution, chunk) -> {
                    var context = chunk.getStepContext().getStepExecution().getJobExecution().getExecutionContext();
                    var state = (JclJobState) context.get(STATE_KEY);
                    var outcome = runner.runStep(definition, step, state);
                    context.put(STATE_KEY, state);
                    contribution.setExitStatus(!outcome.ran() ? new ExitStatus("BYPASSED")
                            : outcome.abended() ? new ExitStatus("ABENDED", outcome.message())
                            : new ExitStatus("COMPLETED", "RC=" + outcome.returnCode()));
                    return RepeatStatus.FINISHED;
                }, transactions)
                .build();
    }
}
//// FILE: JclJobsConfiguration.java
// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
package {{Package}};

import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.ComponentScan;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Condition;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.ConditionContext;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Conditional;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.FilterType;
import org.springframework.core.type.AnnotatedTypeMetadata;
import org.springframework.core.type.classreading.MetadataReader;
import org.springframework.core.type.classreading.MetadataReaderFactory;
import org.springframework.core.type.filter.TypeFilter;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

// Datasets resolve under jcl.datasets.root unless a DatasetCatalog bean says otherwise; utilities
// default to DefaultJobUtilities unless a JobUtilities bean is supplied.
@Configuration
public class JclJobsConfiguration {
    @Bean
    public JclJobRunner jclJobRunner(List<BatchProgram> programs,
                                     ObjectProvider<DatasetCatalog> catalog,
                                     ObjectProvider<JobUtilities> utilities,
                                     @Value("${jcl.datasets.root:}") String root) {
        var datasets = catalog.getIfAvailable(() -> {
            if (root.isBlank()) throw new IllegalStateException("Set jcl.datasets.root, or supply a DatasetCatalog bean.");
            return new DirectoryDatasetCatalog(Path.of(root));
        });
        return new JclJobRunner(programs, datasets, utilities.getIfAvailable(DefaultJobUtilities::new));
    }

    // The converted programs are CDI beans. Spring registers the CDI-scoped classes under
    // jcl.programs.package too, so the runner finds the batch programs and what they inject.
    // Set jcl.programs.scan=false when the programs are already Spring beans.
    @Configuration
    @Conditional(ScanPrograms.class)
    @ComponentScan(basePackages = "${jcl.programs.package:{{ProgramsPackage}}}",
            includeFilters = @ComponentScan.Filter(type = FilterType.CUSTOM, classes = CdiBeans.class))
    static class ProgramScan { }

    static final class ScanPrograms implements Condition {
        @Override
        public boolean matches(ConditionContext context, AnnotatedTypeMetadata metadata) {
            return !"false".equalsIgnoreCase(context.getEnvironment().getProperty("jcl.programs.scan", "true").trim());
        }
    }

    static final class CdiBeans implements TypeFilter {
        private static final Set<String> SCOPES = Set.of(
                "jakarta.enterprise.context.ApplicationScoped",
                "jakarta.enterprise.context.Dependent",
                "jakarta.enterprise.context.RequestScoped",
                "jakarta.inject.Singleton");

        @Override
        public boolean match(MetadataReader reader, MetadataReaderFactory factory) {
            var metadata = reader.getAnnotationMetadata();
            return metadata.isConcrete() && SCOPES.stream().anyMatch(metadata::hasAnnotation);
        }
    }
}
